LanguageData.LP_ALB_Swift.label: elixir of swiftness
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Tough.label: elixir of resilience
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Light.label: elixir of lightness
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Light.description: Light as the wind underfoot: walking ignores slowdown from terrain, snow and plants.
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Lucid.label: elixir of clarity
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Lucid.description: A crystal-clear mind: consciousness +10%, no sleepiness.
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Courage.label: elixir of courage
LanguageData.LP_ALB_Courage.description: Courage wells up: mood +10, mental break threshold -5%.
LanguageData.LP_AL_SavantBuff.label: alchemical savant
LanguageData.LP_AL_SavantBuff.description: Drug-making skill: making vanilla drugs (drug lab recipes) +30% speed.
LanguageData.LP_AL_ResistBuff.label: alchemical resistance
LanguageData.LP_AL_ResistBuff.description: The body has long been steeped in potions: poison and acid damage taken -50%, no toxic buildup in toxic fallout or toxic gas.
LanguageData.LP_AR_ArmorOn.label: arcane armor
LanguageData.LP_AR_ArmorOn.description: Wearing arcane armor personally modified by an Armorer: the armor no longer slows movement. Infiltrator mode movement +10%; after armor modifications, all three armor values +15%; perfected armor is fully sealed (immune to toxic fallout, toxic gas and vacuum). Stops working when taken off or swapped.
LanguageData.LP_AR_Marked.label: infiltrator's mark
LanguageData.LP_AR_Marked.description: Marked by an Armorer's tracking rune: can't turn invisible, and the next hit from a teammate deals +50% damage.
